stories.title: Construction worker jailed for life for killing bus driver after smoking dispute

en.title: Construction worker jailed for life for killing bus driver after smoking dispute
en.summary: A 52-year-old construction worker in Hong Kong has been sentenced to life imprisonment for fatally beating a 48-year-old bus driver who objected to his smoking while waiting for a lift at a residential complex in September 2023.

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics revealed: 1 scientist receives honor
en.summary: The Swedish Royal Academy of Sciences awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics to one scientist for decisive contributions to the IceCube neutrino observatory and discovery of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos.

stories.title: Public outcry as China nurse dies after on-duty brain bleed, but death ruled not work-related

en.title: Public outcry as China nurse dies after on-duty brain bleed, but death ruled not work-related
en.summary: A 30-year-old nurse at a hospital in southwestern China died from a brain hemorrhage while working in August, prompting public anger after authorities declined to classify the death as occupational.

en.title: Francis Halzen wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics
en.summary: An 82-year-old Belgian scientist was awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for significant contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and the discovery of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos.

stories.title: Hong Kong remains world’s freest economy as Switzerland overtakes Singapore

en.title: Hong Kong remains world's freest economy as Switzerland overtakes Singapore
en.summary: Hong Kong retained its position as the world's freest economy according to the Fraser Institute's 2026 ranking, though its score has declined recently. Switzerland moved into second place, displacing Singapore to third among 165 ranked economies.

en.title: China's Transsion, Africa's top phone maker, targets US$500 million Hong Kong listing
en.summary: Shenzhen Transsion Holdings, which makes Africa's best-selling phones, is launching a Hong Kong share offering this week to raise up to US$500 million, with listing targeted for October 15. The company already trades in Shanghai with a market capitalisation of 62 billion yuan.
